scope: Three complete local static contracts; no execution oracle, heap-internal or whole-file compatibility claim
abi: cdecl supported by plain RET, R18 caller cleanup and owned call-site POP cleanup; DWORD stack arguments; EAX raw result; no direct EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI writes; transitive preservation depends on callee ABI

functions.reads: Require F<unsigned DWORD[de43e0]; page=DWORD[de42e0+4*(signed32(F)>>5)]; entry=page+8*(F&31); BYTE entry+4 bit0x01 required
functions.success: Return raw DWORD entry+0; no memory write or call; stored 0 and 0xffffffff are not rejected
functions.ambiguity: Returned -1 can be stored success value without either error-global write
functions.R18_context: Seek caller 0094c57f obtains handle; helper validation failure clears de2f90, whereas open stored -1 leaves it unchanged before caller error9 write
functions.limits: No signed-negative check beyond unsigned bound, page/handle validation, OS call, lock or fault recovery; invalid table memory can fault before error writes

effects_order: Discard eight argument bytes; return callee EAX unchanged
functions.limits: Global flag meaning, allocator state/ownership/errors and exceptional behavior are not established by the native library name

functions.cutoff: Unsigned size>0xffffffe0 => return0 with no calls; equality and zero proceed
effects_order: Zero EAX and flag argument zero => return0
Zero EAX and flag argument nonzero => call 0094895b(size)
Callback zero => return0; callback nonzero => repeat allocation call without repeating entry cutoff
functions.retry: Flag slot reread after each failed allocation; any nonzero flag/callback DWORD is accepted; no local retry limit; original size forwarded assuming callees preserve caller argument storage
functions.R18_context: Stream-buffer helper passes size0x1000 through _malloc; inline fallback is reached only when chain returns zero normally
functions.limits: No local rounding, zero-size substitution, direct error-global update, synchronization or exception handling; allocator helper and callback remain unresolved

unresolved_dependencies.boundary: Underlying allocation result, writes, errors, ownership, synchronization and exceptional effects
Callback dispatch/identity, writes, errors and exceptional effects; only raw zero/nonzero retry result mapped

remaining_limits: No descriptor/table lifetime or concurrency guarantee
No transitive RNG exclusion or connected subsystem equivalence
